title: Start Here
description: Meet Meridian Outfitters and the order that could not ship, then get oriented in the parts Solace Agent Mesh is made of and the broker underneath them

title: Connectors
description: Give agents access to external systems: a SQL connector for the operations database and an MCP connector for the merchandising catalog, both without writing code

title: The Agent
description: Define the agent that owns a fulfillment exception, see what its guardrails forbid, and watch a second agent become available to the Orchestrator through agent card discovery

title: Toolsets and Skills
description: Move substitution scoring out of the prompt into deterministic Go, change one weight to flip the business answer, then package brand voice and credit policy as a skill any agent can load

title: The Workflow
description: Assemble the parts into a declared graph of steps, with a tool node that scores candidates with no model in the loop and a switch that escalates to a human

title: Events
description: Publish one message to the event mesh and watch the workflow run with nobody clicking anything, then see the outcome come back on a topic with no publisher code written

title: Evaluation (take-home)
description: Replay twenty historical exceptions against the agent and score whether the substitutions hold up, before anyone runs this at peak volume

title: CLI Appendix (take-home)
description: Reference material on the sam CLI: declarative configuration, repository layout, secrets, promoting between environments, and packaging toolsets and skills
